NONE: › Western ideas about the Middle East and about East and Southeast Asia, especially ideas that are too simple or not accurate about these societies being mysterious, never changing, or not able to develop in a modern way without Western help
東方主義
› a person who studies the languages and cultures of East and Southeast Asia
東方研究者，東方學專家
› relating to
orientalism

T usually + adv/prep: › to aim something at someone or something, or make something suitable for a particular group of people
以…為目標；使面向；使適應

NONE: › to discover your position in relation to what is around you
確定自己的位置，識別方向

example: It is essential that the public sector orientates itself more towards the consumer.
公共部門要以客為尊，這是最基本的。
If you get lost while you are out walking, try to use the sun to orientate yourself.
如果你外出散步時迷了路，可試試靠太陽辨別方向。

NONE: › directed towards or interested in something
以…為目標的；面向…的；對…感興趣的
-oriented

example: The industry is heavily orientated towards export markets.
該行業主要面向出口市場。

U: C2 the particular things that a person prefers, believes, thinks, or usually does
（某人的）特別喜好，價值取向，信仰觀念
› the particular interests, activities, or aims of an organization or business
C2 training or preparation for a new job or activity
（對新工作、新活動的）培訓，準備

example: We employ people without regard to their political or sexual orientation.
我們聘請員工時並不考慮其政治或性取向。
the company's new eco-friendly orientation
公司保護生態環境的新定位
The department has arranged an orientation session.
這個部門安排了一次崗前培訓。
The building has an east-west orientation (= it is built on a line between east and west).
這幢大樓是東西向的。

NONE: › showing the direction in which something is aimed
以…為目標的；以…為導向的

example: She wants to turn the company into a profit-oriented organization.
她想把公司變成一個以營利為目的的機構。

NONE: › an activity in which you have to find your way to somewhere on foot as quickly as possible by using a map and a compass
定向越野賽，越野識途賽跑（利用地圖和指南針徒步覓路的一項體育運動）
› an opening or hole, especially one in the body, such as the mouth
（尤指身體的）孔，竅，穴，腔

example: humorous I was stuffing cake into every available orifice.
我身上能塞的地方全都塞滿了蛋糕。
formal The driver was bleeding from every orifice.
司機七孔流血。

NONE: › written abbreviation for origin or originates from (= comes from): used to say which part of the body a disease starts from in the body
（身體內的）病源（origin或originates from的縮寫）
› the art of making objects for decoration by folding sheets of paper into shapes
摺紙藝術

example: Origami comes from Japan, where it is still widely practised.
摺紙藝術源於日本，在那裡現在仍然有很多人從事這一行業。

C: B2 [ C ] also origins the beginning or cause of something
› [ C ] specialized medical the end of a muscle attached to the bone that does not move when the muscle is used
› used to describe the particular way in which something started to exist or someone started their life

U: C1 [ U ] where a person was born
B2 [ U ] where an object was made

example: It's a book about the origin of the universe.
這是一本關於宇宙起源的書。
Her unhappy childhood was the origin of her problems later in life.
她不幸的童年導致她後來生活中的諸多問題。
What's the origin of this saying? (= Where did it come from?)
這格言出自甚麼地方？
The story has obscure origins (= no one knows how it started).
這個故事的起源已不可考。
The president's family was of humble origins (= they were poor people without a good position in society).
總統家庭出身卑微。
He is of North African origin.
他是北非裔人。
What is your country of origin?
你出生在哪個國家？
The furniture was French in origin.
這傢俱產於法國。

usually before noun: B1 [ usually before noun ] existing since the beginning, or being the earliest form of something
B2 [ usually before noun ] An original piece of work, such as a painting, etc. is produced by the artist and not a copy.
原作的，真跡的，非贗品的

NONE: B1 approving not the same as anything or anyone else and therefore special and interesting
獨創的，有創意的，新穎的
B2 the first one made and not a copy
原版，原件，原稿
B2 a piece of work by a famous artist or designer and not a copy by someone else
原作，真跡，真品
› If you read something in the original, you read it in the language in which it was first written.
用原著的語言，以原文

example: Is this the original fireplace?
這是原先的壁爐嗎？
The gardens have recently been restored to their original glory.
這些園林最近恢復了原先的輝煌。
an original drawing/manuscript
原畫／稿
Is this an original Rembrandt? (= Was it painted by him?)
這是倫勃朗的原作嗎？
She's a highly original young designer.
她是個很有創意的年輕設計師。
Opposite
unoriginal
Can you give me the original of your report? I can't read this copy.
能把你報告的原件給我嗎？我看不清這份影印本。
If the painting is an original, it will be very valuable.
如果這幅畫是原作，會非常值錢。

NONE: › the right of a court to be the first to hear a legal case
初審管轄權
› in the Christian religion, the idea that all humans are born with a tendency to be evil
（基督教的）原罪
› the quality of being special and interesting and not the same as anything or anyone else
獨創性，創造性

example: We were impressed by the originality of the children's work.
孩子們作品的獨創性給我們留下了深刻的印象。

NONE: B2 first of all
原本，起初，原先

example: Originally it was a bedroom, but we turned it into a study.
這原本是間睡房，但我們把它改成了書房。

I: C2 [ I ] to come from a particular place, time, situation, etc.
T: › [ T ] to start something or cause it to happen

example: Although the technology originated in the UK, it has been developed in the US
儘管這項技術起源於英國，但它在美國得到了發展。

據認為，這項運動始於阿拉斯加的土著人。
Who originated the saying "Small is beautiful"?
「小即美」這句話最早是誰說的？

NONE: › the person who first thinks of something and causes it to happen
創始人，開創者

example: He is best known as the originator of a long-running TV series.
他最著名的是首創了長期連播的一部電視連續劇。

NONE: › a type of colourful European or North American bird
（歐洲）擬黃鸝；（北美）金黃鸝
